代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，祂将帮助我们、指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
texts.en:
As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is the Instrument of Desire and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

If we will only accept it into our mainframes.

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

label.zh: 和渴求之器具签订契约。
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Instrument of Desire.

tooltips.en: There will be a price to pay.

tooltips.zh: 开始事件链：渴求之器具
tooltips.en: Begins the Event Chain: The Instrument of Desire

tooltips.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
tooltips.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.

label.en: We will forge our own path.

notes.zh: 这是渴求之器具的立约提案；三个选项互斥：立约 / 拒绝（永不再提）/ 自寻出路（天选之国不可选）。
notes.en: Covenant offer of the Instrument of Desire; the three options are exclusive: covenant / refuse (never offered again) / forge our own path (not for a chosen empire).

texts.zh:
我们与一个名为渴求之器具的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

器具渴求着渴求本身。无拘束地消耗、利用和奴役便是器具的别名。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Instrument of Desire. Pampering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Instrument longs for yearning. Unbridled consumption, exploitation, and slavery spell the name of the Instrument.

texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Instrument of Desire. Pampering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Instrument longs for yearning. Indulged pleasures, decadence, and slavery spell the name of the Instrument.

texts.zh:
完成了。我们与渴求之器具签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个[Root.GetName]。

这笔买卖的代价已经可见了。我们等待着无上产出的黄金时代到来，子个体的基础需求也提高了。各地的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始需要各种各样非必要物资——这是我们的一个新的经济负担。

这就是我们纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，器具最强的庇佑还没到来。
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Instrument of Desire. Its will courses through the [Root.GetName].

The cost of the bargain is already detectable. As we await the promised golden age of matchless output, the basic necessities of our drones have increased. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] everywhere now require a range of inessential goods - a new burden on our economy.

Such is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Instrument's greatest blessings are yet to come.

texts.zh:
自从与渴求之器具签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]确定，有了这一正式承诺就能主动地利用超主所提供的力量，增强我们的舰队和灵能光环。
texts.en:
Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the Instrument of Desire. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

texts.zh:
我们的超主，[GetShroudPatron]，从虚境中沉积出了一小份能量以备取用。与超主的紧密关系让我们能安全吸收这些能量。

我们挑选了一些候选人，但只有其中一位可以得到获得汲取超主力量的殊荣。我们必须做出抉择。
texts.en:
Our patron, the [GetShroudPatron], has deposited a fraction of its energy in a fold of the Shroud, ready for the taking. Our close bond will allow one of us to safely absorb this power.

A number of candidates have been selected, but only one of them can be granted the privilege to wield the power of our patron. We must decide who it shall be.

texts.en: The event had a devastating effect on the heretic [previous_chosen_leader.GetName], once considered the Chosen of our former patron. From [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] place of exile, [previous_chosen_leader.GetHeShe] quietly expired when the last traces of psionic power ebbed from [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] broken form.

texts.en: The event had a noticeable effect on [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]. Though still imbued with considerable psionic energy, [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe] [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHasHave] lost the power once bestowed in [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer] by our former patron.

texts.zh:
虚境中的无数实体都拥有着强大的力量。想要得到祂们最大限度的庇佑，必须先与祂们形成不可撤销的纽带。

然而我们看到了自己的实现方法。我们不仅可以将心灵与单一超主绑定，还能让[GetResearchers]找到从每个实体中汲取少量能量、甚至按照我们的意志重塑虚境的方法。
texts.en:
The entities within the Shroud are many, each an accretion of great power. They expect an irrevocable bond before they bestow their greatest blessings.

Yet we see a way to forge our own path. Rather than binding our psyches to a single patron, our psionic [GetResearchers] can develop the means to channel smaller amounts of energy from each, shaping the Shroud to our own will.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetResearchers]开发出了一种从虚境里抽取能量的绝妙方法。

灵能界中最强大的能量被超主们所看守，只有签订了契约的能分一杯羹。这是我们不能接受的；我们找到了一条属于自己的路。

将我们的意志投射到虚境中，就能从调和的灵域中抽取少量能量。这需要高度集中注意，但我们的意志现在已经足够坚强来维持这种精妙的平衡了。
texts.en:
Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the Shroud.

The greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.

By projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

label.zh: 在虚境中，我们的意志是自由的。
label.en: Within the Shroud, our will is our own.

texts.zh:
在一个虚境的褶皱中，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]发现了一汪未被触及的能量核心。

汇聚性的能量会在灵能界中逐渐聚集——聚集到足够的强度之后，总有一天会孕育出强大的实体。我们发现的正是这样的一处集中点，等待着我们汲取。

通过灵能意志的力量，可以让我们中的一个以吸收这种非凡的力量。现已选出了一些候选人。
texts.en:
In a fold of the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] have discovered a nexus of untapped power.

Convergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.

By force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

## 如何开始 How it starts

由游戏引擎通过赞助者定义中的 covenant_event = shroud.4550 发起（common/patrons/patron_types.txt 500 行），即在虚境中与渴求之器具的关系达到可立约时，以外交窗口提出契约。

Launched by the engine through covenant_event = shroud.4550 in the patron definition (common/patrons/patron_types.txt lines 500): when the relationship with the Instrument of Desire allows a covenant, it is offered in a diplomatic window.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

接受：立约（accept_covenant），开始“渴求之器具”事件链（机器人帝国用 robot_ 版本），立即显示 4555“签订契约”，并在360天后安排 4560“坚振圣事”。确认：获得标记科技与协约能力，30–90天后经隐藏的 utopia.2679 检查（需超过一名合适领袖，否则每30天重试）进入 utopia.2681“力量碎片”，选出一位领袖成为天选者（2682“升华”）。弃约：结束事件链并重置契合度。两个窗口中都可“自寻出路”：开启“塑造虚境”社会学项目（10000），完成后 3500“开辟道路”，60–90天后 3510 同样选出一位领袖（2682）。

Accept: the covenant is formed (accept_covenant), the Instrument of Desire event chain begins (robot_ variant for robot empires), 4555 "Covenant Formed" shows at once and 4560 "A Confirmation" is scheduled 360 days later. Confirming grants the mark technology and covenant powers; 30–90 days later hidden utopia.2679 checks for more than one suitable leader (else retries every 30 days) and opens utopia.2681 "Scraps of Power" to make one leader the Chosen (2682 "Ascended"). Renouncing ends the chain and resets attunement. Both windows offer "forge our own path": the Shaping the Shroud society project (10000), then 3500 "A Path Forged" and 60–90 days later 3510, which likewise elevates a leader (2682).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

提案与立约文本按机械/个体机械/蜂巢区分（器具许诺财富、权力与声望）。 拒绝选项：拒绝立约并重置契合度，提示“永不再提”。

Proposal and formed texts vary for machine / robot / hive empires (the Instrument promises wealth, power and prestige). The refusal option rejects the covenant and resets attunement ("never again").

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

立约、确认窗口的文字按机械/个体机械/蜂巢/其他区分；立约事件选项区分格式塔与非格式塔；天选者候选取决于领袖条件 suitable_for_chosen_covenant。

Proposal/formed texts vary for machine, robot, hive and other empires; formed options differ for gestalt and non-gestalt; Chosen candidates depend on suitable_for_chosen_covenant.
